metadata.sourceAccess: Only the blind source corpus was read; every source of each case was considered together. No engine, first labels, predictions, reports, UI, or other corpora were read.
metadata.rubric: high: prize, mandatory payment/purchase/donation for eligibility, final random winner, and no unresolved contradiction. Additional organizer income is unnecessary. low: explicit free access, definitive skill/jury result without final randomness, ordinary sale, or contextualized quotation/warning without an own offer. medium: incomplete or unclear core terms, or unresolved contradictions.
